programmes.t: Longines FEI Jumping World Cup - Western European League
programmes.d: The Longines FEI Jumping World Cup Series features qualifying competitions held around the world and a Final each Spring. In order to earn points in qualifying competitions, athletes must be registered to a World Cup League.
